integrity: Proof uses exact pivot laws, Schur complements, projector-distance triangle inequality, and a factored one-variable sharp constant. Standalone exact-algebra tests support rather than replace the universal proof. Earlier equivalent specialist derivations remain a precedence risk; no independent assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Result is an exact-arithmetic rank-two expected trace-residual comparison only for real 3-by-3 strictly positive-definite unit-diagonal matrices; no higher-dimensional, complexity, other-norm, or samplewise guarantee. The sharp upper ratio is a supremum approached through ill-conditioned matrices.
title: Sharp one-fifth trace-error gap between sequential Cholesky pivots and two-point determinant sampling on correlation kernels
